rationale: SQLite resolves unqualified names temp -> main -> attached, so a same-named view in main makes every existing query read the union unchanged. Option A had no SQL mechanism (real tables have no repo column; supplying one forks all 13 query sites into dynamic UNION ALL) and did not scope superseded_by()'s on-disk join; remapping both ids at the view layer and prefixing issue_id/supersedes per member resolves both collision surfaces in workspace_quality.py alone.
rule: Option C — union views in main with the discriminator baked into issue_id/issue_num, plus a prefixed on-disk issues list; no shared query site changes
alternatives_rejected: Option A: repo discriminator threaded through every keying site (previously selected); Option B: issue_num-only remap in views
